query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecules) as total_molecules,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM recette_molecules) as molecules_with_recipes,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recettes) as total_recipes,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plants) as total_plants,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT plant_id) FROM plant_terroirs) as plants_with_terroirs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM terroirs) as total_terroirs,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT terroir_id) FROM plant_terroirs) as terroirs_with_plants,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plant_terroirs) as total_plant_terroir_links;
